titleEs: Eorzea Collection vs FFXIV Collect — inspiración o tracking
titleEn: Eorzea Collection vs FFXIV Collect — inspiration or tracking
descriptionEs: Eorzea Collection es el catálogo visual de glamour builds creados por la comunidad. FFXIV Collect es el tracker de tu collection personal. Diferentes problemas, mismo space.
descriptionEn: Eorzea Collection is the visual catalog of community-created glamour builds. FFXIV Collect is the personal collection tracker. Different problems, same space.
verdictEs: Eorzea Collection para inspiración de glamour y discovery de combinaciones. FFXIV Collect para accounting de qué mounts/minions/achievements tienes y qué te falta. Complementarios.
verdictEn: Eorzea Collection for glamour inspiration and discovering combinations. FFXIV Collect for accounting of which mounts/minions/achievements you have and what's missing. Complementary.

useCases.reasonEs: Eorzea Collection es un catalogue visual con miles de builds curados por users. FFXIV Collect no muestra builds, solo trackea collection.
useCases.reasonEn: Eorzea Collection is a visual catalog with thousands of user-curated builds. FFXIV Collect doesn't show builds, only tracks collection.

useCases.labelEs: Tracking de completion personal de mounts/minions
useCases.reasonEs: FFXIV Collect cruza tu Lodestone con el master list y te dice porcentaje y items faltantes. Eorzea Collection no integra con tu char.
useCases.reasonEn: FFXIV Collect crosses your Lodestone with the master list and tells you percentage and missing items. Eorzea Collection doesn't integrate with your char.

useCases.reasonEs: FFXIV Collect permite linkear chars y ver collection side-by-side. Eorzea Collection no tiene esa funcionalidad.
useCases.reasonEn: FFXIV Collect lets you link chars and see collection side-by-side. Eorzea Collection has no such functionality.

useCases.labelEs: Encontrar inspiración para tu próximo glamour
useCases.labelEn: Find inspiration for your next glamour
useCases.reasonEs: Eorzea Collection es donde la fashion community publica builds curated. FFXIV Collect es accounting tool, no discovery.
useCases.reasonEn: Eorzea Collection is where the fashion community publishes curated builds. FFXIV Collect is an accounting tool, not discovery.

useCases.labelEs: Listar achievements pending con source de cada uno
useCases.labelEn: List pending achievements with their source
useCases.reasonEs: FFXIV Collect filtra por 'not owned' y muestra cómo obtener cada item. Eorzea Collection no maneja achievements.
useCases.reasonEn: FFXIV Collect filters by 'not owned' and shows how to get each item. Eorzea Collection doesn't handle achievements.
